architectural_fidelity.reason: Same room geometry preserved: white walls maintained, ceiling height consistent, window positions and sizes accurate, radiators under windows intact, wooden flooring preserved, camera angle and viewpoint identical to original

furniture_removal.reason: All original furniture completely removed with no ghost outlines, remnants, or phantom shadows - clean slate achieved throughout the space

style_commitment.reason: Strong mid-century modern execution: tapered leg furniture, period-appropriate credenza, iconic lounge chairs, brass floor lamp, geometric rug pattern, walnut wood tones, and curated artwork all demonstrate unmistakable MCM vocabulary

editorial_density.reason: Architectural Digest level styling with multiple vignettes: 5+ plants throughout, layered textiles (rug, throw pillows, upholstery), wall art grouping, brass task lamp, credenza styling with books and objects, side tables with decorative items, multiple light sources creating lived-in sophistication

photorealism.reason: Excellent lighting coherence with natural window light casting realistic shadows across floor, proper material textures on wood furniture and textiles, no CGI plasticity, shadows and highlights behave naturally

designer_preference_reason: Cova delivers the requested mid-century style with editorial polish while Collov's bedroom renders, though technically proficient, show a completely different room type and generic contemporary aesthetic.
what_cova_does_better: Executes the specific COVAMIDCENTURY style with authentic period details and design vocabulary
Maintains perfect architectural fidelity to the original living room space
Achieves editorial-level accessorizing with curated vignettes throughout
Natural photorealistic lighting that enhances rather than overwrites the space
what_collov_does_better: N/A - Collov renders show a different room type (bedroom vs living room) serving only as quality benchmarks
